verdict.rationale: First-party docs list several subscribable webhook types: Configuration, Payment method, Transfer, Dispute, Negative balance warning and Report. Further pages document payment and transfer event webhooks, network token lifecycle webhooks, and relayed authorisation webhooks that are configured in the Customer Area with a 2000 ms response window. Missing for 10: no evidence on webhook signature verification (HMAC), retry/delivery guarantees, or API-based subscription management, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
